About the job

If you dream about spending the day on the Moon, but you are one of those who get sick on bendy drives... Your place is here! We are expanding our teams in the space sector.

What challenge will you be taking on?

  • Design, develop and maintain algorithms for high-precision GNSS positioning and navigation.
  • Develop features and improve the PNT/GNSS engine using modern C++.
  • Analyse algorithm performance using real and simulated datasets.
  • Integrate GNSS receivers, IMUs and other sensors into hardware platforms.
  • Participate in R&D on positioning and sensor-fusion techniques.
  • Validate algorithms through field testing and performance analysis.
  • Develop Python tools for data processing, testing and automation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate navigation solutions.

What do we need?

Graduates in Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or a related field, with experience in modern C++ and Python, technical or algorithm-based software, Linux, Git, analytical thinking and problem solving.

What do we offer?

  • Hybrid work and 8 weeks per year working remotely outside the usual geographical area.
  • Flexible start and finish times; intensive Fridays and summer hours.
  • Personalized career plan, training and language-learning support.
  • National and international mobility and a relocation package where applicable.
  • Competitive and reviewed compensation, flexible benefits and discounts.
  • Health, dental and accident insurance and a wellbeing program.

GMV promotes equal opportunity, inclusion and diversity.
